correctness.rationale: Exact N+k count; graph incidence impossibility at N=2^k-k (including nonempty ordinary path for k>=3); direct k=2 obstruction; explicit all-k>=4 construction by deleting 2k-1 distinct de Bruijn edges with a single duplicate, complete weak-connectivity proof, degree-balance Eulerian trail. k=1..3 separately verified. Python checker constructs and scans all cyclic windows for k=1..12 and exhaustively excludes shorter cases for k=2..4. Finite tests corroborate but are not used to prove all-k.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Cut immediately after the joker and append the first k-1 literal bits to obtain a one-joker linear host of length N+k-1. originality.rationale: The 2010 one-hole exact coverage theorem is noncyclic and its lower bound gives only L>=2^k-k for a cyclic host, not the proven sharp L>=2^k-k+1. The 2018 k-mer joker coverage paper treats a periodic-template optimization and states algorithmic/ILP and generic bounds rather than this exact one-joker-total cyclic formula in material inspected. Exactly-once universal partial cycles are a different property. Targeted semantic searches for both the formula and equivalent single-wildcard cyclic covering formulations found no dominating result; a risk of an unindexed equivalent remains.
residual_risks: An equivalent exact one-joker cyclic covering result may appear under partial-word subword-complexity or generalized de Bruijn terminology in older unindexed literature.
Some mathematical expressions from the 2018 article are rendered as images and were not inspected in the accessible indexed text; exact hidden special cases cannot be excluded by text snippets.
Semantic search is neither an exhaustive literature census nor an independence certification.

value.rationale: Exact all-order optimum with one fixed joker for universal k-mer library coverage; the balance obstruction makes the naive ideal N=2^k-k impossible at every k, yet the deficiency is exactly one and attained constructively. Distinguishes cyclic boundary closure from known linear one-hole optima and from exact-once universal cycles. The object and precise invariant are motivated by universal factor coverage under a minimal degeneracy budget.
